package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/entireio/external-agents/agents/entire-agent-omp/internal/omp"
	"github.com/entireio/external-agents/agents/entire-agent-omp/internal/protocol"
)

func main() {
	agent := omp.New()
	if len(os.Args) < 2 {
		fatalf("usage: entire-agent-omp <subcommand> [args]")
	}

	var err error
	switch os.Args[1] {
	case "info":
		err = protocol.WriteJSON(os.Stdout, agent.Info())
	case "detect":
		err = protocol.WriteJSON(os.Stdout, agent.Detect())
	case "get-session-id":
		err = protocol.HandleGetSessionID(os.Stdin, os.Stdout, agent)
	case "get-session-dir":
		err = protocol.HandleGetSessionDir(os.Args[2:], os.Stdout, agent)
	case "resolve-session-file":
		err = protocol.HandleResolveSessionFile(os.Args[2:], os.Stdout, agent)
	case "read-session":
		err = protocol.HandleReadSession(os.Stdin, os.Stdout, agent)
	case "write-session":
		err = protocol.HandleWriteSession(os.Stdin, agent)
	case "read-transcript":
		err = protocol.HandleReadTranscript(os.Args[2:], os.Stdout, agent)
	case "chunk-transcript":
		err = protocol.HandleChunkTranscript(os.Args[2:], os.Stdin, os.Stdout, agent)
	case "reassemble-transcript":
		err = protocol.HandleReassembleTranscript(os.Stdin, os.Stdout, agent)
	case "compact-transcript":
		err = protocol.HandleCompactTranscript(os.Args[2:], os.Stdout, agent)
	case "format-resume-command":
		err = protocol.HandleFormatResumeCommand(os.Args[2:], os.Stdout, agent)
	case "parse-hook":
		err = protocol.HandleParseHook(os.Args[2:], os.Stdin, os.Stdout, agent)
	case "install-hooks":
		err = protocol.HandleInstallHooks(os.Args[2:], os.Stdout, agent)
	case "uninstall-hooks":
		err = agent.UninstallHooks()
	case "are-hooks-installed":
		err = protocol.WriteJSON(os.Stdout, protocol.AreHooksInstalledResponse{Installed: agent.AreHooksInstalled()})
	case "get-transcript-position":
		err = protocol.HandleGetTranscriptPosition(os.Args[2:], os.Stdout, agent)
	case "extract-modified-files":
		err = protocol.HandleExtractModifiedFiles(os.Args[2:], os.Stdout, agent)
	case "extract-prompts":
		err = protocol.HandleExtractPrompts(os.Args[2:], os.Stdout, agent)
	case "extract-summary":
		err = protocol.HandleExtractSummary(os.Args[2:], os.Stdout, agent)
	default:
		fatalf("unknown subcommand: %s", os.Args[1])
	}
	if err != nil {
		fatalf("%v", err)
	}
}

func fatalf(format string, args ...any) {
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, format+"\n", args...)
	os.Exit(1)
}

Review done. Verdict below.

## PR #43 — Add Oh My Pi external agent

**No malicious code found.** Clean.

### Security scan — all clear
- **Zero third-party deps.** `go.mod` stdlib-only, same as goose/amp/qwen.
- **No network.** No `net/http`, no `Dial`, no sockets, no exfil. Not in prod code, not in tests.
- **`os/exec` = 1 use:** `exec.LookPath("omp")` in `Detect()`. No `Command`/shell.
- **`base64`** = compact-transcript encoding only. Benign.
- **Env vars** (`PI_CONFIG_DIR`, `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR`, `OMP_PROFILE`, `XDG_*`) read only to build local session paths — never sent anywhere.
- **Injected extension** (`.omp/extensions/entire/index.ts`, embedded as string in `hooks.go:342`): spawns fixed `entire hooks omp <name>` via `execFile` (no shell → no injection), payload on stdin. No network. `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` prepend on bash tool calls = prevents git credential hangs, standard.
- **File I/O** defensive throughout: atomic writes, `0600`/`0700` perms, symlink guards (`ensurePrivateDir`), path-traversal checks (`relativeWithin`, `canonicalPath`), session-ID whitelist validation, `LimitReader` caps.
- Docs clean — no `curl | bash`.

### Pattern compliance — matches existing agents
- Structure identical (`cmd/`, `internal/omp`, `internal/protocol`, `go.mod`, `mise.toml`, `AGENT.md`, `README.md`).
- Same protocol command set (minus optional `calculate-tokens`/`prepare-transcript`).
- Same `mise.toml` build/test/clean tasks.
- Injection pattern consistent: goose writes JSON hook config, omp writes host-native TS extension — both just invoke the `entire` binary. omp **more** defensive: ownership-marker check refuses to clobber foreign extensions (`hooks.go:301`).
- README + e2e registration wired correctly.

### One real issue (non-blocking, not malicious)
Build passes. **2 unit tests fail on macOS** (pass on Linux CI):
- `TestEncodeSessionDirName` — `paths_test.go:122`
- `TestParseHookLifecycle` — `hooks_test.go:77`

Cause: macOS `os.TempDir()` = `/var/folders/…` (symlink → `/private/var/…`). Tests build **non-existent** subpaths, so `EvalSymlinks` can't normalize them; the `/private` prefix mismatch defeats `relativeWithin`, so the code falls to the full-path branch. **Production code is fine** — real cwds exist and canonicalize correctly. Pure test-portability gap.

Fix suggestion for author: canonicalize the expected path in the test (e.g. run inputs through `filepath.EvalSymlinks(os.TempDir())`) instead of assuming `TempDir()` is already canonical.

### Recommendation
**Approve** once the two macOS tests are made portable (or explicitly marked Linux-only). No security concerns.
